comments.body: I dont think that is true if you keep working in chemistry. Even outside academia a PhD has a lot of worth, especially at a top institution, without it you can’t really be group leader or anything more than research assistant in any company. But of course if you don’t wanna keep working in the field and become idk a manager than there is no reason to do it. But I think he wouldn’t be asking it if he wanted that
